text.nb:
Kontroll. Kari beskriver nedstemthet, tidlig morgenoppvåkning, tap av glede og konsentrasjonsvansker i fire måneder, med gradvis forverring. PHQ-9 i dag: 14.

Gjennomgår skilsmisse, har nylig flyttet til ny kommune og mistet sosialt nettverk. 50 % sykemeldt siste to uker. Fortsatt i arbeid, men har trukket seg tilbake sosialt og sluttet med fritidsaktiviteter.

Tidligere behandling: Rask psykisk helsehjelp i seks uker, uten bedring. Sertralin 50 mg for fem år siden med god effekt, seponert.
text.en:
Follow-up. Kari describes low mood, early morning waking, loss of pleasure and difficulty concentrating for four months, gradually worsening. PHQ-9 today: 14.

Going through a divorce, has recently moved to a new municipality and lost her social network. 50% sick leave for the last two weeks. Still working, but has withdrawn socially and stopped her leisure activities.

Previous treatment: Rask psykisk helsehjelp for six weeks, without improvement. Sertraline 50 mg five years ago with good effect, discontinued.

description.nb: Usikker på om dette er en reaktiv tilpasningsforstyrrelse eller en begynnende moderat depressiv episode. Funksjonsfallet er til stede, men mildt. Manglende respons på kommunalt tilbud taler for spesialistvurdering, men kort varighet og tydelig reaktiv komponent taler mot.
description.en: Uncertain whether this is a reactive adjustment disorder or an emerging moderate depressive episode. Functional decline is present but mild. Lack of response to municipal services argues for specialist assessment, but short duration and clear reactive component argue against.

text.en: Kari had a depressive episode in 2020, treated with sertraline 50 mg by her previous GP, with good effect. Now she wakes early, often around four o’clock, and has less appetite than usual. She is still on 50% sick leave and has no suicidal thoughts.
